messages:
nina: Seeing duplicates in staging from POSTs after client timeouts. The SDK replay path is firing and dropping my Idempotency-Key header.

patrick: can you share minimal snippet?

nina: 
```py
async with AsyncClient() as c:
    headers = {"Idempotency-Key": key}
    try:
        await c.post('/v1/items', json={'name':'a'}, headers=headers, timeout=2.0)
    except httpx.ReadTimeout:
        pass
```
Edge shows client timed out; replay-controller retried 1s later without header and backend created a second item.

owen: root cause: replay serializes request.headers to a list-of-tuples then reconstructs; our serializer drops headers with unusual casing and duplicates are possible. Also replay runs outside coroutine, so context props aren't present.

patrick: fix plan: (1) normalize headers to lowercase on serialize/deserialize, (2) preserve user-supplied Idempotency-Key (case-insensitive), (3) add config `replay_on_client_timeout=false` by default, (4) expose typed RetryPolicy dataclass for per-client config, (5) add unit+integration test that simulates httpx.ReadTimeout and verifies single create with idempotency key.

build-bot: created issue #3702 and assigned to @owen

owen: opened PR #3720 with header deep-copy + tests. also docs note about which statuses are safe to replay (500/502/503/504).

qa: reproduced fix on staging; duplicates gone when key is present. temporary workaround: set client.default_headers['Idempotency-Key'] or disable replay.

nina: thanks all. leaving notes in SDK migration guide.
